title: group_snapshot v1
description: Summary of one read of the group file. Emitted once per pass, after every group_record of the same run_id. Emitted even when the file could not be read; then no group_record is emitted.

group_status.description: read, unreadable, or implausible (no GID 0 entry).

group_error.description: Only when group_status is not read.

records_emitted.description: group_record facts emitted in this run_id. Only when read.
